notes.title: Altered access method to adult only content
notes.content:
Following steam's new content policy, we altered the access method to adult only content.

Followings are procedure to access adult only content.: 
1.Enable mature content access.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31195508/437492e6a2fae3df2dd13c2d55c4c1092ac27ab9.png[/img]

2.Install [b]Free DLC[/b]"Tenta Shooter / The 触シュー Adult Only Content".
https://store.steampowered.com/app/960180/

We also altered censorship method. 
If you prefer previous censorship, you can change censorship method in following way.:
1.Select "r18alt" in steam client Tenta Shooter / The 触シュー properties, 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31195508/dfa296550c4267f65adc2eff66b4908d303dd075.png[/img]
2.Disable Hentai filter in game option.

We will not update previous version any more,  so please try it at your own risk.
You can go back to the newest version by selecting "NONE" in beta tab.

Thank you!

notes.title: [Patchnote:Ver1.02] Overhaul for simplified Chinese translation, bug fixes and improvements.

[*]Improved Simplified Chinese translations.
[*]Bullet counter gauge is max at continue in arcade mode.
